gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically or cytologically confirmed glioblastoma, according to World Health Organization \[WHO\] 2021 with unequivocal first progression

candidate_evidence.quote: aiming to assess the efficacy of the combination of trimipramine and atezolizumab with bevacizumab in patients with recurrent glioblastoma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Efficacy of the Combination of Trimipramine and Atezolizumab With Bevacizumab in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma: a Phase 2 Trial

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Level of trimipramine in the tumor tissue and CSF collected during surgery will be assessed by measuring the trimipramine concentration by laboratory analysis.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Consent to giving access of part of the tumor tissue and Cerebrospinal Fluid \[CSF\] obtained during the routine neurosurgical procedure for pharmacology and translational studies.

role_evidence.quote: Eligible patients will receive: trimipramine, bevacizumab and atezolizumab.

arms: Cohort 1: Recurrent GBM without indication for re-resection
Cohort 2: recurrent GBm with an indication for re-resection

role_evidence.quote: Eligible patients will receive: trimipramine, bevacizumab and atezolizumab.
Atezolizumab: intravenous administration at 1200 mg on the first day of 3-week cycles.

arms: Cohort 1: Recurrent GBM without indication for re-resection
Cohort 2: recurrent GBm with an indication for re-resection

role_evidence.quote: All patients will receive the combination treatment (trimipramine and atezolizumab associated with bevacizumab) for a maximum period of 2 years from registration.

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-VEGF monoclonal antibody; established GBM therapy
arms: Cohort 1: Recurrent GBM without indication for re-resection
Cohort 2: recurrent GBm with an indication for re-resection

coder_notes: Atezolizumab and bevacizumab are registered as separate per-cohort interventions; each coded as one row covering both cohorts. Bevacizumab given in all arms as background ('associated with bevacizumab'); its start is delayed after surgery in cohort 2 for practical reasons, not as the investigational question, so soc_backbone rather than established_therapy_experiment. Tumour/CSF translational studies mentioned but no specific pharmacodynamic endpoint linked to a candidate, so target_engagement coded no.
